spriteComponent.name: Sprite
spriteComponent.event: component("spriteName"):SetString("$spriteName") local layer = "$layer" if element:HasVar("layer") then layer = element("layer"):GetString() end component("layer"):SetString(layer)

component:setScale(lua_sys.Vector2(1, 1))
local scaleW = element("TargetLength"):GetFloat()/component:absW() local scaleH = element("TargetLength"):GetFloat()/component:absH() local minScale = math.min(scaleW, scaleH)
component:setScale(lua_sys.Vector2(minScale, minScale))

spriteSheetComponent.name: SheetSprite
spriteSheetComponent.event: component("spriteName"):SetString("islands_button_isl01") component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/island_buttons01.xml") local layer = "$layer" if element:HasVar("layer") then layer = element("layer"):GetString() end component("layer"):SetString(layer)

component:setScale(lua_sys.Vector2(1, 1))
local scaleW = element("TargetLength"):GetFloat()/component:absW() local scaleH = element("TargetLength"):GetFloat()/component:absH() local minScale = math.min(scaleW, scaleH)
component:setScale(lua_sys.Vector2(minScale, minScale))

spriteSheetComponent.name: SelectedSprite
spriteSheetComponent.event: component("spriteName"):SetString("select_checkmark") component("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/buttons02.xml") component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.windowScaleY()) component("visible"):SetInt(0) local layer = "$layer" if element:HasVar("layer") then layer = element("layer"):GetString() end component("layer"):SetString(layer)
